item.title: Incarico post-doc: Leaky-wave focused ultrasound through metamaterial engineering – Focusing ultrasonic leaky waves using metamaterials - 2026_IPD_DMEC_9 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-02 Meccanica applicata alle macchine

The research activity focuses on the development and validation of acoustic-metamaterial-based solutions for controlling ultrasound propagation and focusing, with particular reference to non-invasive transcranial focusing. The project integrates the modelling of acoustic-wave propagation in complex media, ultrasound interaction with structures and metasurfaces, leaky-wave engineering, metamaterial design, and spatial control of the ultrasound field. The research will also include laboratory experiments for manufacturing and validating the developed devices, and for assessing their ability to focus ultrasound under representative conditions. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Scalable Fabrication of Multifunctional Slippery Liquid-Infused Porous Metal Surfaces with Hierarchical Porosity Using Cold Spray - 2026_IPD_DMEC_11 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-03 Progettazione industriale, costruzioni meccaniche e metallurgia

The research activity is to develop metallic porous surfaces infused with lubricating liquids (Slippery Liquid-Infused Porous Surfaces, SLIPS) using Cold Spray technology. The project will explore innovative strategies for producing porous deposits by optimizing process parameters and employing pore-forming agents and erosive particles. The resulting deposits will then be functionalized and infused with lubricants to create SLIPS. The research will include the microstructural and mechanical characterization of the materials, as well as the evaluation of their performance under different environmental conditions. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-02 Impianti e processi industriali chimici

The researcher will develop laboratory-scale and modelling systems for the production of green hydrogen and its conversion into sustainable fuels, based on technologies conceived and patented at Politecnico di Milano. In particular, a low-energy-demand, high-temperature SOEC system will be developed for water electrolysis and the production of hydrogen and oxygen. A first-principles, multiscale model will be developed to optimise electrolysis operation and its process integration with chemical synthesis systems. item.title: Incarico post-doc: ReaCer - Reactive sintering of ceramics – project code FA8655-26-1-B029 (CUP E63C26001640005) (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IMAT-01 Scienza e tecnologia dei materiali

ReaCer aims to develop a new fundamental understanding of the consolidation mechanisms activated in reactive hydrothermal liquid-phase sintering, RHLPS. The main goal is to identify a kinetic model for the process and bind it to the physics of the system. This will allow us to clarify the rate-controlling bottlenecks for the reactive consolidation, the diffusion pathways, and the activation energy of the process. Remarkably, the assumptions behind this consolidation approach are mechanistically different from those mastering the traditional solid-state sintering models. The fellow should propose a set of experiments that will allow the identification of a physical model for the system…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Determination of Mercury’s gravity field from radio-metric data of the spacecraft BepiColombo and MESSENGER (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The research activity will focus on the data analysis of the MORE (Mercury Orbiter Radio science Experiment) investigation on board ESA’s (European Space Agency) BepiColombo probe during the first year of the mission’s orbital phase. The activity will include regular orbit determination of the spacecraft and the analysis of Doppler and range data to measure Mercury’s gravity field, also including in the analysis the non-gravitational acceleration measurements from the ISA accelerometer and the radio tracking data acquired by NASA’s MESSENGER mission

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Development and fine-tuning of experimental methods based on image analysis for the analysis of steady and unsteady flows (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The research activity involves the design and development of innovative measurement systems based on image analysis, for measuring both velocity and temperature fields in experimental fluid-mechanics. The focus is on non-invasive measurement techniques such as Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) and Thermal Imaging (TI). In particular, the aim is to study fluid fields using cameras with innovative Event-Based sensors, for both hydrodynamic and aerodynamic flows. Engineering applications will include internal flows in micro-channels, for the study of heat transfer, the turbulent jets, for the investigation of multiphase dynamics and external flows for studying wakes of models in wind tunnel
